name: law
summary: Professional, worn down, and by the book: bound forward behind suppression, never move both elements at once, and withdraw before a losing fight becomes a lost one.

movement.why: halted: herringbone, sectors assigned, nothing unwatched
halted in the open: coil, all-round security
screening by the book: a line, and never both elements moving
base of fire: suppress, then let the others move
contact: bound forward behind suppressive fire, one element always set
close country: column through the lanes, bounding between covered positions
contact possible: wedge, trail element overwatching
